verdict_reason: All 25 tiles were sampled and 8 different photographers are represented, yet almost every frame is the same road junction seen from the same elevated vantage. The identifying text repeats across photographers and across years: the blue street plates 'LE THAI TO' and 'CAU GO', shop fascias '104 HANG DAO' and 'THOI TRANG 102 HANG ...', and the fixed signs HDBank, HAFASCO, CADI-SUN, Air Asia, Thai Village and Long Van. Several frames are shot from the curved, stepped-balcony 'Ham ca map' building at 1-3-5 Dinh Tien Hoang - one photo is of its own 'HIGHLANDS COFFEE' roof neon, another shows its lit brass balcony rail in the corner of frame, and the cafe-terrace snapshots carry Highlands' 'Jamaica Blue Mountain' table cards. That junction of Le Thai To / Cau Go / Hang Dao / Dinh Tien Hoang is Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square at the north tip of Hoan Kiem Lake, about 150 m north-east of the pin. Independent photographers converging on one identifiable spot is the signature of a real place, not a dumping ground. Three tiles (a blurred vendor, a chopstick sleeve, a night portrait) carry no locational content but nothing contradicts.
place_if_genuine: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Dusk view down onto the multi-way junction. Left: the white colonial corner block with a first-floor restaurant terrace, 'Thai Village' lettering and yellow 'LONG VAN' shop signs at street level. Right: the 'HAFASCO' blue fascia, a 'Tiger' beer board and market stalls. Bottom right corner: a curved balcony rail outlined in warm neon - the balustrade of the Ham ca map building the photographer is standing on. Cyclos, a green-and-white taxi and a swarm of motorbikes on the open asphalt.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Second frame of the same dusk view, same white colonial corner block with restaurant terrace and 'LONG VAN' signs, same 'HAFASCO' and 'Tiger' boards on the right, same neon-lit curved balcony rail of the photographer's own building in the lower right corner.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Night snapshot of four travellers around a glass table on an open terrace, with a fan palm, a glass-and-steel balustrade, and a 'Jamaica BLUE MOUNTAIN' coffee table card (a Highlands Coffee line). Over the balustrade, street lights and shopfronts below and, at the right edge, a colonial facade outlined in blue fairy lights - the same building this photographer shoots square-on in 3505828738 / 3505833758. Consistent with the Highlands Coffee terrace on the Ham ca map building above the square.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Two men talking at the same glass table, same rolled-parasol posts, same 'Jamaica Blue Mountain' table card, dark cityscape and a hint of street light beyond the balustrade. Same terrace as 3505008089, seconds apart; the terrace itself is what places it, not anything in this frame.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Third frame of the same pair at the same table, same parasol post and 'Jamaica Blue Mountain' card, cafe terrace at night. Placed by continuity with 3505008089, not by anything visible in this frame.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Looking up along a roof edge at large red channel-letter neon reading '...GHLA[NDS]' with a smaller 'CAFE - RE[STAURANT]' board behind it, mounted on a curved concrete fascia. That is the HIGHLANDS COFFEE roof sign on the curved 'Ham ca map' building at 1-3-5 Dinh Tien Hoang, on the north side of the square.

photos.place: UNIDENTIFIED
photos.evidence: Flash portrait of a woman in a pink t-shirt holding a shoulder bag at night, in front of a dark shopfront row with parked motorbikes and a small illuminated sign that is not legible. No street plate, house number or landmark.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Night view across the square at a large colonial block whose whole upper facade is traced in blue fairy lights, with a circular medallion in the raised central bay. Below it a lit restaurant terrace and an arcaded ground floor with 'HONG VAN' (camera shop - Olympus / Canon / Panasonic lettering beside it), 'HSBC', a green 'Phytopharco' cross, 'KFC' and a yellow 'Hanoi Season' sign. The arcaded ground floor, terrace level and medallion in the top bay match the white corner block that the daylight photos of this pile show carrying 'Thai Village' and 'LONG VAN' on Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Wider frame of the same blue-lit colonial block with the medallion bay, the lit terrace floor and the arcade below reading 'HONG VAN', 'HSBC', 'KFC' and a yellow sign, with a palm frond intruding at the right from the photographer's terrace. Same building and same vantage as 3505828738.

photos.place: UNIDENTIFIED
photos.evidence: Deliberately motion-blurred black-and-white close-up of a street vendor in a conical hat carrying two woven baskets on a shoulder pole, passing a parked scooter. Vietnamese, but no building, sign or landmark is resolvable anywhere in the frame.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Street-level view of the curved, stepped-balcony 'Ham ca map' building read from its own signs: 'HIGHLANDS COFFEE' along the top floor, 'Legend beer' in red script on the corner, 'LEGEND BEER' on the middle balcony, 'SWAROVSKI' twice on the silver-fringed first floor with a Swarovski shop window, and 'ALDO' on the adjoining white shopfront. Crowds of motorbikes waiting on the open square in front. This is 1-3-5 Dinh Tien Hoang on Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Elevated daylight view of the junction with legible fascias: '104 HANG DAO' over a shop awning, 'DAI THONG', a red 'Air Asia.com' board, and on the left the white colonial corner block with a 'LONG VAN' sign and a '1001' style roundel. Green-and-white and red-and-white taxis, a zebra crossing and dense motorbike traffic.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Tight elevated shot of a wave of motorbikes and bicycles crossing bare grey asphalt, with a zebra crossing at the top of frame. No sign is in view; it is placed by being one of the same photographer's sequence shot from the same balcony as 5678884827 and 5679446032, which do carry legible street names.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Wide elevated view with several independent reads: a blue street plate at bottom right lettered 'CAU GO', shop fascias '104 HANG DAO' and 'THOI TRANG 102 HANG ...', plus 'HDBank', 'HAFASCO', 'Air Asia.com', 'THAI VILLAGE' with '1001' on the white colonial corner block, and 'Ly cafe' boards. That names the Cau Go / Hang Dao corner of Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Elevated shot of pedestrians waiting at a kerb and bicycles and motorbikes streaming across a zebra crossing, with a red-and-white striped awning at the top left. No legible sign; placed by continuity with the same photographer's 5679446032 and 5678884827 from the same balcony.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Night view over the junction with yellow 'LONG VAN' signs on the arcaded white colonial corner block at left (restaurant terrace lit above it), and 'HDBank', 'HAFASCO' and 'CADI-SUN' neon on the right-hand side; cyclos, a red-and-white taxi and a green-and-white taxi in the intersection.

photos.place: UNIDENTIFIED
photos.evidence: Extreme close-up of a wooden chopstick sleeve printed 'AAA VERY GOOD NO.1' with a Vietnamese address line too small and dark to read, lying beside metal cutlery on a table. A restaurant table somewhere, with nothing that fixes a location.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Night view over the same junction: 'HDBank' neon and 'CADI-SUN' and 'HAFASCO' fascias on the right, the arcaded white colonial corner block with yellow 'LONG VAN' signs at the left, market stalls and cyclos along the pavement, a bus and taxis in the road.

photos.place: Hanoi Old Quarter
photos.evidence: The one frame in this pile that is NOT the square: a woman in the foreground on a balcony, looking down a narrower street lined with backpacker businesses - a 'BOOKING OFFICE' with a 'Jetstar' shutter and an 'ATM', neon reading 'Sago Bar' and 'SAGO BAR ...' on a first-floor terrace, a red 'NGOC HOA' hoarding and a roof crowned with a row of white lights. Travel booking offices plus upstairs bars is Old Quarter backpacker territory; I could not pin 'Sago Bar' or 'Ngoc Hoa' to a street, so I stop at district.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Rain-slicked night view of the same junction with reflections on the wet asphalt: the white colonial corner block with its arcade and yellow 'LONG VAN' signs and lit terrace on the left, 'HDBank', 'CADI-SUN' and 'HAFASCO' on the right, taxis and motorbikes trailing light.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Wet-night frame of a balloon seller's mass of red and yellow foil balloons on the square, with cyclos parked at the kerb and clothing stalls under blue tarpaulins behind - the same stall row that appears under the 'CADI-SUN' / 'HAFASCO' signs in this photographer's other frames of the junction.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Same balloon seller on the wet square, this time with the red 'CADI-SUN' neon and the blue 'HAFASCO' fascia legible above the stalls at the top of frame, cyclos and motorbikes on the reflective asphalt.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Another wet-night frame with 'CADI-SUN' and 'HAFASCO' legible at the top, the balloon seller mid-square, a yellow taxi crossing the foreground and stalls under tarpaulins along the right pavement.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Elevated night view with 'CADI-SUN', 'HAFASCO' and 'HDBank' neon along the right-hand block, 'BBQ Chicken' on the near corner building, the arcaded white colonial corner block with its terrace at the left, a balloon seller in the middle of the junction and cyclos parked along the kerb.

photos.place: Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Dusk view from above with a blue street plate at the bottom left legible as 'LE THAI TO', and the white colonial corner block signed 'THAI VILLAGE' with a decorative roundel and '1001' motif, people on its roof terrace, a Standard Chartered billboard on the building opposite, and traffic funnelling into the junction under a hazy orange sun.
